name: slump
description: Multivariate regression data set from: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2Fs10994-016-5546-z : The Concrete Slump dataset (Yeh 2007) concerns the prediction of three properties of concrete (slump, flow and compressive strength) as a function of the content of seven concrete ingredients: cement, fly ash, blast furnace slag, water, superplasticizer, coarse aggregate, and fine aggregate.
